title: Officer who shot man returns to line of duty: [Early Edition]
article: The police officer who fatally shot a knife-wielding man two weeks ago is back on the job.
Const. Ira Macumber returned to work Tuesday.
Deng Fermino Kuol, 34, was shot by Macumber Oct. 25, after a struggle outside an apartment building at 1709 37th St. S.E.
Kuol was sitting outside the residence when the police officer arrived. Investigators said that after initially agreeing to leave, Kuol drew a knife and slashed the officer in the left bicep.
Macumber struggled to restrain his attacker, then pulled his gun and fired twice -- in keeping with officer training, according to police.
The shooting sparked outrage from members of Calgary's Sudanese community, who are calling for an independent judicial inquiry. The Calgary Police Service continues to investigate the incident.

At the time of the shooting, there was a warrant for Kuol's arrest after he failed to appear to face charges of assaulting a peace officer and not complying with a probation order to abstain from drinking alcohol, court documents show.
It's believed Macumber, a father of three, was aware of the charges before he entered the building.
